events.name: Stack Overflow Jobs
events.note: Stack Overflow Jobs and Developer Story were discontinued on March 31, 2022, with no successor job board.

source.title: The end of Stack Overflow Jobs: here's what it means for you - hackajob
source.quote: On March 31, 2022, we will discontinue Stack Overflow Jobs and Developer Story.

events.name: GitHub Jobs
events.note: GitHub announced the deprecation of GitHub Jobs in April 2021 and sunset the site on August 19, 2021.

source.title: Deprecation notice: GitHub Jobs site - GitHub Changelog
source.quote: Today we are announcing the deprecation of GitHub Jobs and, on August 19th, will sunset the site entirely.

events.name: Hired
events.note: Vettery acquired the Hired job marketplace in November 2020.

source.title: Vettery acquires Hired - TechCrunch
source.quote: Two large job search and recruiting platforms are coming together, with Vettery acquiring Hired.

events.name: Workopolis
events.note: Indeed, owned by Recruit Holdings, bought Workopolis in 2018; the site now works as a white-label portal for Indeed postings. Sources differ on the month.

source.title: Details of Indeed's acquisition of Workopolis - ERE
source.quote: Indeed announced it had purchased Workopolis, a well-known job board in Canada on April 4

events.name: Oracle Taleo
events.note: Oracle acquired Taleo, a talent acquisition software vendor, in 2012; the Taleo name remains an Oracle product.

source.title: Taleo - Wikipedia
source.quote: On February 9, 2012, Oracle Corporation acquired Taleo Corporation for $1.9 billion.

events.name: Monster Worldwide
events.note: Randstad completed its acquisition of Monster Worldwide on November 1, 2016; Monster continued as a separate brand. The current CSV owner is recorded differently and was not rechecked here.

source.title: Randstad completes acquisition of Monster Worldwide - Randstad press release
source.quote: it has completed its acquisition of Monster Worldwide, Inc.

events.name: Jobr
events.note: Monster.com acquired the San Francisco job search app Jobr in June 2016.

source.title: Monster snaps up 'Tinder for jobs' app, Jobr - TechCrunch
source.quote: Monster.com announced this morning it has acquired the San Francisco-based startup Jobr

events.name: Glassdoor
events.note: Recruit Holdings completed its acquisition of Glassdoor on June 21, 2018; Glassdoor kept operating as a separate unit.

source.title: Recruit Holdings announces completion of Glassdoor acquisition - PR Newswire
source.quote: Recruit Holdings Co., Ltd. today announced it has completed its previously announced acquisition of Glassdoor.

events.name: SimplyHired
events.note: Recruit Holdings acquired the assets of Simply Hired on July 1, 2016; the site kept running as a job search destination.

source.title: Indeed owner Recruit Holdings confirms acquisition of Simply Hired - TechCrunch
source.quote: Recruit Holdings Co., Ltd. hereby announces that it has acquired the assets of Simply Hired, effective today.

events.name: Google Hire
events.note: Google announced in August 2019 that Google Hire would stop running on September 1, 2020, citing a shift in priorities.

source.title: Google shuts down Hire, the product it acquired with Diane Greene - CNBC
source.quote: On Tuesday the company informed Hire administrators that it would stop running the service on Sept. 1, 2020.
